"""Phrasebook demo for the Translator Service record 1: What a Translator Does.
A small working phrasebook translator: a table of checked phrases in
four languages, translating this record's own title words where it can,
and saying plainly what it does not cover."""
import hashlib
TITLE = "What a Translator Does"
QUERY_WORDS = 'what translator does'
PHRASES = {
    "hello": {"es": "hola", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Hallo", "it": "ciao"},
    "good morning": {"es": "buenos dias", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Guten Morgen", "it": "buongiorno"},
    "goodbye": {"es": "adios", "fr": "au revoir", "de": "auf Wiedersehen", "it": "arrivederci"},
    "please": {"es": "por favor", "fr": "s'il vous plait", "de": "bitte", "it": "per favore"},
    "thank you": {"es": "gracias", "fr": "merci", "de": "danke", "it": "grazie"},
    "sorry": {"es": "lo siento", "fr": "desole", "de": "es tut mir leid", "it": "mi dispiace"},
    "yes": {"es": "si", "fr": "oui", "de": "ja", "it": "si"},
    "no": {"es": "no", "fr": "non", "de": "nein", "it": "no"},
    "water": {"es": "agua", "fr": "eau", "de": "Wasser", "it": "acqua"},
    "bread": {"es": "pan", "fr": "pain", "de": "Brot", "it": "pane"},
    "coffee": {"es": "cafe", "fr": "cafe", "de": "Kaffee", "it": "caffe"},
    "help": {"es": "ayuda", "fr": "au secours", "de": "Hilfe", "it": "aiuto"},
}
def translate(text, lang):
    low = text.lower().strip()
    if low in PHRASES:
        return PHRASES[low][lang]
    words = low.split()
    out = []
    for w in words:
        if w in PHRASES:
            out.append(PHRASES[w][lang])
        else:
            out.append("[" + w + ": not in this phrasebook]")
    return " ".join(out)
print("Translator Service phrasebook demo - record 1: What a Translator Does")
print("Phrasebook entries: %d" % len(PHRASES))
for lang in ("es", "fr", "de", "it"):
    print("  hello -> %s (%s)" % (translate("hello", lang), lang))
print("Query words: " + QUERY_WORDS)
print("Spanish: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "es"))
print("French: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "fr"))
joined = "|".join(translate("hello", lang) for lang in ("es", "fr", "de", "it"))
h = hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
print("Test: 'hello' in Spanish is 'hola' - " + ("pass" if translate("hello", "es") == "hola" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'thank you' in French is 'merci' - " + ("pass" if translate("thank you", "fr") == "merci" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'goodbye' in German is 'auf Wiedersehen' - " + ("pass" if translate("goodbye", "de") == "auf Wiedersehen" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'water' in Italian is 'acqua' - " + ("pass" if translate("water", "it") == "acqua" else "fail"))
print("Test: an unknown word is marked not in the phrasebook - " + ("pass" if "not in this phrasebook" in translate("zqxwv", "es") else "fail"))
print("Test: translation is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))

A small working phrasebook translator: a table of checked phrases in
four languages, translating this record's own title words where it can,
and saying plainly what it does not cover."""
import hashlib
TITLE = "Please, Thank You and Sorry"
QUERY_WORDS = 'please thank sorry'
PHRASES = {
    "hello": {"es": "hola", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Hallo", "it": "ciao"},
    "good morning": {"es": "buenos dias", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Guten Morgen", "it": "buongiorno"},
    "goodbye": {"es": "adios", "fr": "au revoir", "de": "auf Wiedersehen", "it": "arrivederci"},
    "please": {"es": "por favor", "fr": "s'il vous plait", "de": "bitte", "it": "per favore"},
    "thank you": {"es": "gracias", "fr": "merci", "de": "danke", "it": "grazie"},
    "sorry": {"es": "lo siento", "fr": "desole", "de": "es tut mir leid", "it": "mi dispiace"},
    "yes": {"es": "si", "fr": "oui", "de": "ja", "it": "si"},
    "no": {"es": "no", "fr": "non", "de": "nein", "it": "no"},
    "water": {"es": "agua", "fr": "eau", "de": "Wasser", "it": "acqua"},
    "bread": {"es": "pan", "fr": "pain", "de": "Brot", "it": "pane"},
    "coffee": {"es": "cafe", "fr": "cafe", "de": "Kaffee", "it": "caffe"},
    "help": {"es": "ayuda", "fr": "au secours", "de": "Hilfe", "it": "aiuto"},
}
def translate(text, lang):
    low = text.lower().strip()
    if low in PHRASES:
        return PHRASES[low][lang]
    words = low.split()
    out = []
    for w in words:
        if w in PHRASES:
            out.append(PHRASES[w][lang])
        else:
            out.append("[" + w + ": not in this phrasebook]")
    return " ".join(out)
print("Translator Service phrasebook demo - record 3: Please, Thank You and Sorry")

print("French: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "fr"))

print("Test: translation is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))

"""Phrasebook demo for the Translator Service record 6: Days of the Week in Four Languages.
A small working phrasebook translator: a table of checked phrases in
four languages, translating this record's own title words where it can,
and saying plainly what it does not cover."""
import hashlib
TITLE = "Days of the Week in Four Languages"
QUERY_WORDS = 'days week four languages'
PHRASES = {
    "hello": {"es": "hola", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Hallo", "it": "ciao"},
    "good morning": {"es": "buenos dias", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Guten Morgen", "it": "buongiorno"},
    "goodbye": {"es": "adios", "fr": "au revoir", "de": "auf Wiedersehen", "it": "arrivederci"},
    "please": {"es": "por favor", "fr": "s'il vous plait", "de": "bitte", "it": "per favore"},
    "thank you": {"es": "gracias", "fr": "merci", "de": "danke", "it": "grazie"},
    "sorry": {"es": "lo siento", "fr": "desole", "de": "es tut mir leid", "it": "mi dispiace"},
    "yes": {"es": "si", "fr": "oui", "de": "ja", "it": "si"},
    "no": {"es": "no", "fr": "non", "de": "nein", "it": "no"},
    "water": {"es": "agua", "fr": "eau", "de": "Wasser", "it": "acqua"},
    "bread": {"es": "pan", "fr": "pain", "de": "Brot", "it": "pane"},
    "coffee": {"es": "cafe", "fr": "cafe", "de": "Kaffee", "it": "caffe"},
    "help": {"es": "ayuda", "fr": "au secours", "de": "Hilfe", "it": "aiuto"},
}
def translate(text, lang):
    low = text.lower().strip()
    if low in PHRASES:
        return PHRASES[low][lang]
    words = low.split()
    out = []
    for w in words:
        if w in PHRASES:
            out.append(PHRASES[w][lang])
        else:
            out.append("[" + w + ": not in this phrasebook]")
    return " ".join(out)
print("Translator Service phrasebook demo - record 6: Days of the Week in Four Languages")
print("Phrasebook entries: %d" % len(PHRASES))
for lang in ("es", "fr", "de", "it"):
    print("  hello -> %s (%s)" % (translate("hello", lang), lang))
print("Query words: " + QUERY_WORDS)
print("Spanish: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "es"))
print("French: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "fr"))
joined = "|".join(translate("hello", lang) for lang in ("es", "fr", "de", "it"))
h = hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
print("Test: 'hello' in Spanish is 'hola' - " + ("pass" if translate("hello", "es") == "hola" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'thank you' in French is 'merci' - " + ("pass" if translate("thank you", "fr") == "merci" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'goodbye' in German is 'auf Wiedersehen' - " + ("pass" if translate("goodbye", "de") == "auf Wiedersehen" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'water' in Italian is 'acqua' - " + ("pass" if translate("water", "it") == "acqua" else "fail"))
print("Test: an unknown word is marked not in the phrasebook - " + ("pass" if "not in this phrasebook" in translate("zqxwv", "es") else "fail"))
print("Test: translation is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))

    "thank you": {"es": "gracias", "fr": "merci", "de": "danke", "it": "grazie"},
    "sorry": {"es": "lo siento", "fr": "desole", "de": "es tut mir leid", "it": "mi dispiace"},

"""Phrasebook demo for the Translator Service record 12: Family Words.
A small working phrasebook translator: a table of checked phrases in
four languages, translating this record's own title words where it can,
and saying plainly what it does not cover."""
import hashlib
TITLE = "Family Words"
QUERY_WORDS = 'family words'
PHRASES = {
    "hello": {"es": "hola", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Hallo", "it": "ciao"},
    "good morning": {"es": "buenos dias", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Guten Morgen", "it": "buongiorno"},
    "goodbye": {"es": "adios", "fr": "au revoir", "de": "auf Wiedersehen", "it": "arrivederci"},
    "please": {"es": "por favor", "fr": "s'il vous plait", "de": "bitte", "it": "per favore"},
    "thank you": {"es": "gracias", "fr": "merci", "de": "danke", "it": "grazie"},
    "sorry": {"es": "lo siento", "fr": "desole", "de": "es tut mir leid", "it": "mi dispiace"},
    "yes": {"es": "si", "fr": "oui", "de": "ja", "it": "si"},
    "no": {"es": "no", "fr": "non", "de": "nein", "it": "no"},
    "water": {"es": "agua", "fr": "eau", "de": "Wasser", "it": "acqua"},
    "bread": {"es": "pan", "fr": "pain", "de": "Brot", "it": "pane"},
    "coffee": {"es": "cafe", "fr": "cafe", "de": "Kaffee", "it": "caffe"},
    "help": {"es": "ayuda", "fr": "au secours", "de": "Hilfe", "it": "aiuto"},
}
def translate(text, lang):
    low = text.lower().strip()
    if low in PHRASES:
        return PHRASES[low][lang]
    words = low.split()
    out = []
    for w in words:
        if w in PHRASES:
            out.append(PHRASES[w][lang])
        else:
            out.append("[" + w + ": not in this phrasebook]")
    return " ".join(out)
print("Translator Service phrasebook demo - record 12: Family Words")
print("Phrasebook entries: %d" % len(PHRASES))
for lang in ("es", "fr", "de", "it"):
    print("  hello -> %s (%s)" % (translate("hello", lang), lang))
print("Query words: " + QUERY_WORDS)
print("Spanish: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "es"))
print("French: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "fr"))
joined = "|".join(translate("hello", lang) for lang in ("es", "fr", "de", "it"))
h = hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
print("Test: 'hello' in Spanish is 'hola' - " + ("pass" if translate("hello", "es") == "hola" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'thank you' in French is 'merci' - " + ("pass" if translate("thank you", "fr") == "merci" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'goodbye' in German is 'auf Wiedersehen' - " + ("pass" if translate("goodbye", "de") == "auf Wiedersehen" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'water' in Italian is 'acqua' - " + ("pass" if translate("water", "it") == "acqua" else "fail"))
print("Test: an unknown word is marked not in the phrasebook - " + ("pass" if "not in this phrasebook" in translate("zqxwv", "es") else "fail"))
print("Test: translation is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))

"""Phrasebook demo for the Translator Service record 14: The Weather in Words.
A small working phrasebook translator: a table of checked phrases in
four languages, translating this record's own title words where it can,
and saying plainly what it does not cover."""
import hashlib
TITLE = "The Weather in Words"
QUERY_WORDS = 'weather words'
PHRASES = {
    "hello": {"es": "hola", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Hallo", "it": "ciao"},
    "good morning": {"es": "buenos dias", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Guten Morgen", "it": "buongiorno"},
    "goodbye": {"es": "adios", "fr": "au revoir", "de": "auf Wiedersehen", "it": "arrivederci"},
    "please": {"es": "por favor", "fr": "s'il vous plait", "de": "bitte", "it": "per favore"},
    "thank you": {"es": "gracias", "fr": "merci", "de": "danke", "it": "grazie"},
    "sorry": {"es": "lo siento", "fr": "desole", "de": "es tut mir leid", "it": "mi dispiace"},
    "yes": {"es": "si", "fr": "oui", "de": "ja", "it": "si"},
    "no": {"es": "no", "fr": "non", "de": "nein", "it": "no"},
    "water": {"es": "agua", "fr": "eau", "de": "Wasser", "it": "acqua"},
    "bread": {"es": "pan", "fr": "pain", "de": "Brot", "it": "pane"},
    "coffee": {"es": "cafe", "fr": "cafe", "de": "Kaffee", "it": "caffe"},
    "help": {"es": "ayuda", "fr": "au secours", "de": "Hilfe", "it": "aiuto"},
}
def translate(text, lang):
    low = text.lower().strip()
    if low in PHRASES:
        return PHRASES[low][lang]
    words = low.split()
    out = []
    for w in words:
        if w in PHRASES:
            out.append(PHRASES[w][lang])
        else:
            out.append("[" + w + ": not in this phrasebook]")
    return " ".join(out)
print("Translator Service phrasebook demo - record 14: The Weather in Words")
print("Phrasebook entries: %d" % len(PHRASES))
for lang in ("es", "fr", "de", "it"):
    print("  hello -> %s (%s)" % (translate("hello", lang), lang))

print("Spanish: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "es"))
print("French: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "fr"))

print("Test: 'water' in Italian is 'acqua' - " + ("pass" if translate("water", "it") == "acqua" else "fail"))
print("Test: an unknown word is marked not in the phrasebook - " + ("pass" if "not in this phrasebook" in translate("zqxwv", "es") else "fail"))
print("Test: translation is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))

"""Phrasebook demo for the Translator Service record 17: Emergency Words.
A small working phrasebook translator: a table of checked phrases in
four languages, translating this record's own title words where it can,
and saying plainly what it does not cover."""
import hashlib
TITLE = "Emergency Words"
QUERY_WORDS = 'emergency words'
PHRASES = {
    "hello": {"es": "hola", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Hallo", "it": "ciao"},
    "good morning": {"es": "buenos dias", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Guten Morgen", "it": "buongiorno"},
    "goodbye": {"es": "adios", "fr": "au revoir", "de": "auf Wiedersehen", "it": "arrivederci"},
    "please": {"es": "por favor", "fr": "s'il vous plait", "de": "bitte", "it": "per favore"},
    "thank you": {"es": "gracias", "fr": "merci", "de": "danke", "it": "grazie"},
    "sorry": {"es": "lo siento", "fr": "desole", "de": "es tut mir leid", "it": "mi dispiace"},
    "yes": {"es": "si", "fr": "oui", "de": "ja", "it": "si"},
    "no": {"es": "no", "fr": "non", "de": "nein", "it": "no"},
    "water": {"es": "agua", "fr": "eau", "de": "Wasser", "it": "acqua"},
    "bread": {"es": "pan", "fr": "pain", "de": "Brot", "it": "pane"},
    "coffee": {"es": "cafe", "fr": "cafe", "de": "Kaffee", "it": "caffe"},
    "help": {"es": "ayuda", "fr": "au secours", "de": "Hilfe", "it": "aiuto"},
}
def translate(text, lang):
    low = text.lower().strip()
    if low in PHRASES:
        return PHRASES[low][lang]
    words = low.split()
    out = []
    for w in words:
        if w in PHRASES:
            out.append(PHRASES[w][lang])
        else:
            out.append("[" + w + ": not in this phrasebook]")
    return " ".join(out)
print("Translator Service phrasebook demo - record 17: Emergency Words")
print("Phrasebook entries: %d" % len(PHRASES))
for lang in ("es", "fr", "de", "it"):
    print("  hello -> %s (%s)" % (translate("hello", lang), lang))
print("Query words: " + QUERY_WORDS)
print("Spanish: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "es"))
print("French: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "fr"))
joined = "|".join(translate("hello", lang) for lang in ("es", "fr", "de", "it"))
h = hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
print("Test: 'hello' in Spanish is 'hola' - " + ("pass" if translate("hello", "es") == "hola" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'thank you' in French is 'merci' - " + ("pass" if translate("thank you", "fr") == "merci" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'goodbye' in German is 'auf Wiedersehen' - " + ("pass" if translate("goodbye", "de") == "auf Wiedersehen" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'water' in Italian is 'acqua' - " + ("pass" if translate("water", "it") == "acqua" else "fail"))
print("Test: an unknown word is marked not in the phrasebook - " + ("pass" if "not in this phrasebook" in translate("zqxwv", "es") else "fail"))
print("Test: translation is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))

History

People have carried phrasebooks for centuries, small books of useful sentences in another language for travellers. The first machine translation test, the Georgetown-IBM experiment of 1954, turned sixty Russian sentences into English with a small dictionary and a few rules. Early systems worked by rules written by hand, later systems learned from large collections of translated text, and from 2016 the leading systems learned from whole sentences at once. Phrasebooks never went away: a short list of real phrases, checked by a speaker, is still the most trusted way to say hello, ask the way, and order food abroad. The public references this database cites, the Wikipedia articles on machine translation and phrasebooks, carry that history forward, and every record here names its source.     "hello": {"es": "hola", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Hallo", "it": "ciao"},

    "please": {"es": "por favor", "fr": "s'il vous plait", "de": "bitte", "it": "per favore"},
    "thank you": {"es": "gracias", "fr": "merci", "de": "danke", "it": "grazie"},
    "sorry": {"es": "lo siento", "fr": "desole", "de": "es tut mir leid", "it": "mi dispiace"},
    "yes": {"es": "si", "fr": "oui", "de": "ja", "it": "si"},
    "no": {"es": "no", "fr": "non", "de": "nein", "it": "no"},

"""Phrasebook demo for the Translator Service record 23: What a Phrasebook Cannot Translate.
A small working phrasebook translator: a table of checked phrases in
four languages, translating this record's own title words where it can,
and saying plainly what it does not cover."""
import hashlib
TITLE = "What a Phrasebook Cannot Translate"
QUERY_WORDS = 'what phrasebook cannot translate'
PHRASES = {
    "hello": {"es": "hola", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Hallo", "it": "ciao"},
    "good morning": {"es": "buenos dias", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Guten Morgen", "it": "buongiorno"},
    "goodbye": {"es": "adios", "fr": "au revoir", "de": "auf Wiedersehen", "it": "arrivederci"},
    "please": {"es": "por favor", "fr": "s'il vous plait", "de": "bitte", "it": "per favore"},
    "thank you": {"es": "gracias", "fr": "merci", "de": "danke", "it": "grazie"},
    "sorry": {"es": "lo siento", "fr": "desole", "de": "es tut mir leid", "it": "mi dispiace"},
    "yes": {"es": "si", "fr": "oui", "de": "ja", "it": "si"},
    "no": {"es": "no", "fr": "non", "de": "nein", "it": "no"},
    "water": {"es": "agua", "fr": "eau", "de": "Wasser", "it": "acqua"},
    "bread": {"es": "pan", "fr": "pain", "de": "Brot", "it": "pane"},
    "coffee": {"es": "cafe", "fr": "cafe", "de": "Kaffee", "it": "caffe"},
    "help": {"es": "ayuda", "fr": "au secours", "de": "Hilfe", "it": "aiuto"},
}
def translate(text, lang):
    low = text.lower().strip()
    if low in PHRASES:
        return PHRASES[low][lang]
    words = low.split()
    out = []
    for w in words:
        if w in PHRASES:
            out.append(PHRASES[w][lang])
        else:
            out.append("[" + w + ": not in this phrasebook]")
    return " ".join(out)
print("Translator Service phrasebook demo - record 23: What a Phrasebook Cannot Translate")
print("Phrasebook entries: %d" % len(PHRASES))
for lang in ("es", "fr", "de", "it"):
    print("  hello -> %s (%s)" % (translate("hello", lang), lang))
print("Query words: " + QUERY_WORDS)
print("Spanish: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "es"))
print("French: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "fr"))
joined = "|".join(translate("hello", lang) for lang in ("es", "fr", "de", "it"))
h = hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
print("Test: 'hello' in Spanish is 'hola' - " + ("pass" if translate("hello", "es") == "hola" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'thank you' in French is 'merci' - " + ("pass" if translate("thank you", "fr") == "merci" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'goodbye' in German is 'auf Wiedersehen' - " + ("pass" if translate("goodbye", "de") == "auf Wiedersehen" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'water' in Italian is 'acqua' - " + ("pass" if translate("water", "it") == "acqua" else "fail"))
print("Test: an unknown word is marked not in the phrasebook - " + ("pass" if "not in this phrasebook" in translate("zqxwv", "es") else "fail"))
print("Test: translation is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))
